name: Bolstering Our Defenses
label: Quest
description: Bolstering Our Defenses: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Agents of the Forsaken uncovered an Alliance plot to establish new bases here in the Eastern Plaguelands, at abandoned towers throughout the area.

It is imperative that we not allow them to establish a significant presence on our eastern borders, and so we must stave off this Alliance incursion. Our current plans are to drive them out of any towers they may have already seized, and occupy those that we have under our control against further attacks.

clips.title: Progress
paras: They must be fools to think that we would allow them to establish bases so close to one of our capitals.
We will bleed their numbers until they turn tail and retreat back to the south.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is good news, friend. It will be a constant struggle here in the Plaguelands until we have fully driven back the forces of the Alliance.
Until that day, I hope that we will have your continued assistance.
